en.title: 7 Must-Watch Movies on Prime Video This Week
en.summary: From action-packed thrillers to heartwarming comedies, discover the best films hitting Prime Video this week to elevate your viewing.
en.body:
Prime Video is dropping some serious gems this week, and whether you're craving a laugh, a thrill, or something that tugs at the heartstrings, we've got you covered. Dive into these fantastic picks that are absolutely worth your time.

## 1. The Love Hypothesis
This modern rom-com leans into the beloved fake-dating trope, delivering a delightful dose of humor and undeniable chemistry between its leads. While it might tread familiar ground, the genuine laughs and the compelling performances make it a charming watch, especially praised for its complex character portrayals.

## 2. The Addams Family
Get ready for some spooky fun with this animated feature that brings the iconic, macabre family to life. It’s a visually distinct and darkly comedic adventure that captures the essence of the beloved characters, offering a fresh take for both longtime fans and newcomers.

## 3. Rocky III
Sylvester Stallone returns as the Italian Stallion in this iconic installment of the boxing saga. 'Rocky III' is a masterclass in underdog storytelling, featuring thrilling fight sequences and a compelling narrative about reclaiming one's spirit against formidable new rivals.

## 4. Queenpins
Based on a surprisingly true story, this film hilms with sharp wit and a satirical edge as it follows two suburban housewives who strike gold by running an illegal coupon-cutting empire. It's a fun, fast-paced caper that’s as entertaining as it is outrageous.

## 5. Hairspray
Set in 1960s Baltimore, this vibrant musical bursts with infectious energy, catchy tunes, and a powerful message of acceptance. The story of Tracy Turnblad fighting for integration on a local dance show is a joyous, feel-good spectacle with an unforgettable soundtrack.

## 6. Hunting Season
While critics might have been divided, this 2025 action-thriller has clearly resonated with audiences, topping Prime Video's charts. Starring Mel Gibson as a reclusive survivalist drawn into a dangerous conflict, it offers a gritty, intense ride filled with high stakes and unexpected twists.

## 7. The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
While technically a series, its epic scale and cinematic quality warrant a mention for those looking for grand fantasy adventures. This prequel explores the legendary Second Age of Middle-earth, bringing to life the forging of the Rings of Power and the rise of Sauron with breathtaking visuals and rich lore.

Bottom Line: This week's Prime Video lineup is a treasure trove of entertainment, offering something for every taste.

content_raw: Prime Video ’s number one movie this week is RJ Collins ’s 2025 action-thriller Hunting Season . The movie stars Mel Gibson as a reclusive survivalist who, along with his daughter, encounters a mysterious, wounded woman and is forced to confront a deadly gang. Though largely panned by critics, the movie has clearly proven a hit with Prime Video subscribers. However, the streaming service has plenty more to offer, including some iconic crowd-pleasers. Without further ado, here’s a look at three great movies that we think you should watch on Prime Video this week.
